title: The Ontology Atlas
subtitle: What the student must believe a quantity is
summary: An interactive knowledge graph of the ontological error traps in school physics. Each student claim is linked to the quantity it concerns, the kind of thing the student must be taking that quantity to be, the family of error involved, the stage of the modelling chain at which the reasoning broke, and the repair that moves it.

companions.title: The Nouns Beneath the Numbers: Ontological Fluency and the Difficulty of School Physics
Ontological Fluency in Physics: Diagnostic and Classroom Tasks

classroom_use: Starter or display: the Atlas arrangement, with students naming the kind of thing a quantity is before any calculation
Part III of the workbook: the Five families arrangement, one family per group
Post-assessment review: the Pipeline arrangement, locating where in the chain a wrong answer actually failed
Modelling the four-step diagnosis: select any student claim and read the routine aloud

technical.rendering: hand-written SVG force layout, vanilla JavaScript
accessibility: search rail as a non-spatial route to every node
